prompt: A laptop costs $720 to buy outright. On a payment plan you pay a deposit of 25% of the $720, then 12 monthly payments of $50, plus a one-off $20 plan fee. How much more in total does the payment plan cost than buying outright?
explanation: Deposit: 25% of $720 = $180. Monthly payments: 12 x $50 = $600. Plan total: $180 + $600 + $20 fee = $800. Extra over buying outright: $800 - $720 = $80. The other options come from common slips: $60 forgets the $20 fee ($780 total, $780 - $720 = $60); $100 counts the $20 fee twice ($820 total, $820 - $720 = $100); $130 counts 13 monthly payments instead of 12 ($180 + $650 + $20 = $850, $850 - $720 = $130).
